sn35.244:4.4: Read _taṁ kaṇṭako ti iti viditvā_, which is found at [sn35.247:1.6](), and here in BJT edition.
sn35.244:8.1: This simile is also at [mn66:16.5](), [mn152:9.9](), and [an7.74:7.1]().
sn35.244:9.15: The expression “slants to seclusion” (_vikekaninna_) was adopted by Patañjali at Yogasūtra 4.26.
